description.value: O'Hare's Gastropub is a full-service pub and liquor store in Richmond's Steveston neighbourhood, a popular destination for cyclists exploring the flat dyke trails and waterfront. The venue offers dine-in food service as well as takeout and delivery options. Its combined gastropub-and-liquor-store format makes it a practical stop for resupplying on a longer ride through the Fraser River delta.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 4m; rack at 10m; rack at 95m.
